content.title: Top-Performing ETF Areas of Q3
content.summary: Small caps led Q3 gains, while other standout ETF areas are Bitcoin mining (WGMI, MNRS), cannabis (MSOS, WEED), Ethereum (ETH, ETHW) and rare earths (REMX).

content.title: 5 Best-Performing Sector ETFs of August
content.summary: Marijuana, crypto, materials, healthcare and space ETFs led August gains despite tech volatility. These ETFs are MSOS, REMX, IHF, UFO, and ETHW.

content.title: Ethereum ETF (ETHW) Hits New 52-Week High
content.summary: Bitwise Ethereum ETF ETHW hit a 52-week high, thanks to rising ETH prices, institutional inflows, and supportive crypto legislation.

content.title: Ethereum ETFs Notch Best Day of 2025 as Crypto Price Jumps
content.summary: - Ethereum ETFs pulled in $386 million on Thursday, according to CoinShares. - The ether token has jumped 18% over past week. - Stablecoin legislation is boosting enthusiasm for the cryptocurrency.

Ethereum ETFs extend record inflows: What's behind crypto demand
content.description:
Ethereum (ETH-USD) ETFs have seen consecutive weeks of record inflows since being approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission last year.

etf.com SVP of content and editor in chief Kristin Myers sits down with Madison Mills for a conversation about the investor draw these crypto funds have proven to have as the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) soars past $70 billion in assets under management as bitcoin (BTC-USD) re-approaches its record high.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Catalysts here.

content.title: Ethereum ETFs Jump Post 'Pectra' Network Upgrade
content.summary: - Ethereum ETFs have gained around 26% over past two days. - The Pectra upgrade is intended to make network more competitive with tokens such as Solana. - Ethereum's price has still dropped 25% over the past year.

content.title: Spot Ethereum ETFs Bounce: Legit Rally or Will Gas Run Out?
content.summary: - No. 2 cryptocurrency has gained 25% since April 8; Ethereum ETFs fell Wednesday. - Ethereum ETFs pulled in $245 million over the past 4 days: Coinshares. - Spot bitcoin ETFs have widely outperformed Ethereum this year.

content.title: SEC Delays Staking Decision on Grayscale's ETHE, ETH
content.summary: - The delay follows the SEC naming Paul Atkins chairman on April 9. - The regulatory agency also delayed its choice on in-kind redemptions in crypto ETFs. - The rulings are postponed until June 1.

content.title: SEC Green Lights Options Trading on Ethereum ETFs
content.summary: - The SEC approved filings for options trading on several spot Ethereum ETFs. - The decision was widely expected by market participants. - Ethereum options are likely to be extremely volatile.
